FN-BN81QQJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 297
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 297 as introduced would exempt from income taxes any net capital gains derived
from the exchange of precious metal bullion and would allow deductions to be claimed on any
net capital losses derived from the exchange of precious metal bullion. This could decrease
receipts to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the amount of losses and gains derived from the exchanges.
